subject: Intermittent inference failures impacting checkout — follow-up & goodwill offer
messages:
From: Liam Harper <liam.harper@bluestone.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: ops@bluestone.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent inference failures impacting checkout — urgent

Hi Vanessa,

We saw a burst of 5xx errors from the Redwood inference endpoint used by checkout between 08:50 and 09:10 PT this morning. Several customer checkouts stalled and retried, which caused an elevated error rate and a handful of abandoned carts. I attached an excerpt from our logs showing the upstream 502s and the request ids — hope that helps.

Can you confirm root cause and whether this will affect our peak traffic later today? This is time-sensitive for us — major promotional traffic at 11:00 PT.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam Harper
Director, Site Reliability
Bluestone Retail

Attachments: incident_log_excerpt.txt (text/plain, 6 KB)

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
To: Liam Harper <liam.harper@bluestone.com>
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent inference failures impacting checkout — urgent

Hi Liam — thank you for the heads up and for sending the logs. I'm really sorry for the disruption this morning. Our on-call runtime team is investigating with priority.

Quick update: initial traces point to a cascading queue pressure on one of the serving clusters for your region; the fallback routing didn't fully catch before requests hit 90s queue latency, which led to upstream 502s. We're rolling a mitigant now (shorter local queue thresholds + temporary extra workers) and will monitor the 11:00 PT window closely.

I'll keep you posted with a short timeline and root-cause writeup when available. In the meantime, I've looped in Sean and Hannah to coordinate a customer-facing gesture so you can share something concrete with your leadership and ops teams.

-Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Lead | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

[Internal attachments: none]

From: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent inference failures impacting checkout — urgent

Vanessa / Hannah — thanks for flagging. If the mitigant holds we'll need an offer that does three things: 1) acknowledges impact to Bluestone without legal language, 2) gives them immediate runway for traffic (token grant), and 3) provides a short-term trial extension to offset any lost trials tied to the campaign.

Draft suggestion (for internal review):
- One-time token grant: 200,000 generation tokens applied to Bluestone's account within 24 hours.
- Trial extension: extend any active trial window by 30 days for their dev/test environments.
- Incident summary and RCA to be delivered by EOD Wednesday.

I'll prepare the formal proposal PDF and a DocuSign approval link we can send to the Bluestone execs. Approvals: SEA-SALES-MGR signoff + finance notification.

-Sean Gallagher
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

> On Mon, Mar 22, 2027 at 09:28 AM vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com wrote:
> > Hi Liam — thank you for the heads up and for sending the logs. I'm really sorry for the disruption this morning.

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Liam Harper <liam.harper@bluestone.com>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood proposal: Stability signal & trial stretch for Bluestone (proposal attached)

Hi Liam and Nora,

Appreciate your patience while we finish the short investigation. We've validated the root cause (queue threshold + routing gap) and put permanent safeguards on the serving pool for your region. Full RCA will follow, but we wanted to get a concrete offer in your hands now so you can brief leadership ahead of the noon promo.

Attached is a short one-pager (stability-signal-proposal.pdf) with the offer. Plain language summary below:
- Stability signal grant: 200,000 generation tokens credited within 24 hours to the Bluestone org account. These can be used across environments and will appear as a usage credit in your next invoice.
- Trial stretch: extend any active trial / sandbox windows tied to your account by 30 days to give your team runway to validate the fixes under load.
- RCA & follow-up: technical RCA and mitigation plan delivered by EOD Wednesday, + prioritized postmortem sync if you'd like deeper engineering dive.

If that looks good, reply here with an approval line ("Bluestone accepts the stability signal grant and trial stretch") and I'll send a DocuSign for sign-off.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Growth Programs | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

Attachments: stability-signal-proposal.pdf (application/pdf, 48 KB)

From: Liam Harper <liam.harper@bluestone.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Nora Chen <nora.chen@bluestone.com>, ops@bluestone.com
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal: Stability signal & trial stretch for Bluestone (proposal attached)

Hannah — thank you. The proposal reads well and should be sufficient for our CFO and Head of Product. Bluestone accepts the stability signal grant and trial stretch.

One quick ask: can you include a short note on our invoice stating these were applied as a one-time token grant? That helps our finance team tie this to the campaign impact. Also, please send the DocuSign so our GC can sign.

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the extra monitoring today.

—Liam
